# Search Structure Improvement

The Awtsmoos is one while shell, controls, history, cards, and tracks appear apart;
Awtsmoos.com reveals each concern as a smaller vessel so the cascade itself becomes readable art.

## Split map

- `search-shell.css` -> shell/layout plus history/disclosure module.
- `search-controls.css` -> control foundations plus control interaction/responsive module.
- `search-results.css` -> results shell/summary plus event-card/detail module.
- Keep `search-tracks.css` and `search-fullscreen.css` focused as already written.
- Update only `runtime-ui.css` as the manifest owner.

## Verification

- Every touched CSS/JS/test file <=120 physical lines.
- All CSS imports resolve.
- Search interaction states include hover, active, focus-visible, disabled, reduced-motion.
- Fullscreen uses named layer token and safe-area inset.
- No five-digit search z-index values.
- No runtime search style factory.
